title: Battalion native Android companion app, interactive widgets, and session management
content:
Battalion expands to mobile with a native Kotlin Android companion app featuring live dashboard integration, interactive widgets, and full session recovery.

What changed:

  • Native Android Companion: Built with Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, and OkHttp/Gson for API 26+ Android devices. Features live HP/XP/Gold dashboard meters, category-expanded emotion logging, and a category + masonry action performer with long-press Favorites toggling and HUD confirmation popups.
  • Customizable Home Screen Widgets: Added a 3x1 expandable (up to 5x2) Status Widget that toggles between individual stats (HP, XP, Health) or displays all three when expanded, and a resizable 1x1 Quick-Action shortcut widget featuring in-app shortcut reassignment, favorites filtering, customizable button background colors, and responsive text/emoji sizing.
  • Visual Polish & Art: Integrated battvert03.jpg with a dark gradient scrim for the companion app and login screens, and batthorz01.jpg for home screen widget backdrops.
  • Account & Session Recovery: Added an in-app Account & Session modal with one-tap credential refresh, backstack-clearing logout with prefilled username retention, and automatic HTTP 401 retry recovery.
